svg.aria-label: Three approaches to memory: manual freeing, a garbage collector, or ownership settled at compile time.

svg.text: Forget, and it leaks. Free early, and it crashes.

svg.text: A crew marks what is still reachable, then clears the rest.

svg.text: Costs about 25% of CPU while marking, with brief pauses.

svg.text: Memory is a warehouse. The language decides who empties it.
